name: Onda Shunji
source:
Aisaku's childhood friend, there's a deep bond between them similar to what brothers share.
As a child he lost both his parents in an accident, and was raised in an orphanage of a church. Shunji is the coffee shop manager.
He actively helps out one of his acquaintances related to theater by doing the special effects in a superhero-show.
